title: Charly Clive, Breakout Star of HBO’s ‘Rooster,’ Is Just Getting Started
summary: The actress sits down with THR to discuss what the season finale of Bill Lawrence and Matt Tarses' record-breaking comedy has in store, the ups and downs of a tough industry, and finally getting her break: "Listen, it took a while for Steve Martin. It took a while for Steve Carell. If it takes a while for the Steves, maybe it takes a while for the Charlys."
